matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 251-260 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Victor A/E Kirouac; Maurice J Kleibert/Kliebert; Eugene/Gene L Kocherga; Nick Kochopolus/Kuchopolus; the two Charles E Kopp rows; the two Lawrence Korpita rows; the two Elizabeth Krishna rows; Francis J/S Kruckosky; and the two Virginia J Kuch rows. The review preserves literal and truncated printed forms such as Kjelstrup's Netherla note, Poonperm Krairiksh's Free Th note, Ziggy/ie Klimazewski, Bertrsm Kreis, Egar Kugler, and KunJara capitalization, as well as notes, out-of-sequence boxes, and archive-location transitions exactly as printed. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
